description: This file implements the undo resolution logic for index entries in a version control system, including functions for recording, reading, writing, and clearing resolve-undo data, as well as unmerging index entries based on undo information.

methods.name: void record_resolve_undo(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Records resolve-undo information for a given cache entry within the index state.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct string_list * resolve_undo,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Serializes resolve-undo information into a buffer, including modes and object IDs.

methods.name: struct:string_list * resolve_undo_read(const char * data,unsigned long size,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses resolve-undo data from a memory buffer and reconstructs the resolve-undo list.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_clear_index(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Clears the resolve-undo data associated with the index state.

methods.name: int unmerge_index_entry(struct index_state * istate,const char * path,struct resolve_undo_info * ru,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Unmerges a specific index entry, creating new unmerged entries based on resolve-undo info.

methods.name: void unmerge_index(struct index_state * istate,const struct pathspec * pathspec,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Unmerges index entries according to the resolve-undo information and pathspec.

ctags.signature: (struct index_state * istate,const struct pathspec * pathspec,unsigned ce_flags)
